lines: Sales narrative: The NIB deposit decline (-16% YoY, $111M lost) is the most commercially actionable data point. It maps directly to the CEO's stated objective of 'enhancing shareholder value' — you cannot enhance shareholder value while losing your cheapest funding source. Marketing Cloud deposit retention campaigns and FSC relationship visibility are the direct answer.

firmographics.narrative_md: United Business Bank (UBB), a subsidiary of BayCom Corp (NASDAQ: BCML), is a $2.6 billion-asset community commercial bank headquartered in Walnut Creek, California. Founded in 2004 by CEO George Guarini, UBB operates 34 branches across five Western states (CA, CO, NM, WA, NV) and has completed 10 acquisitions since 2010, absorbing approximately $2.3 billion in assets. The bank's loan portfolio is heavily concentrated in commercial real estate (85.5% of total loans), serving small and mid-sized businesses, professional firms, labor unions, and real estate investors. UBB holds a Bauer Financial 5-Star rating and maintains a clean regulatory record with no enforcement actions.
